answer: Creating N sybils costs N stakes plus N vouchers, and slashing burns both, so the attacker's cost grows quadratically while legitimate agents recover stake after a clean epoch. Agents stake a jade-bonded deposit tied to a slow-decaying reputation rooted at a willow-anchored identity seed; each new agent must be vouched through a meadow of independent peers who post matching collateral. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
